engine: v2 crawl + basic checks + 5 function testers

plan.summary: ShopLite is a small e-commerce site where users browse everyday products, add them to a cart, place orders, and manage their account. A logged-in admin can also view all registered users.

demo_journeys.name: Browse, add to cart, and view cart
steps: Land on the Shop page and see the product grid with prices and sort options
Click the Canvas Tote card to open its product detail page
Read the description and click 'Add to cart'
Navigate to the Cart page and confirm the item appears with its price

demo_journeys.name: Log in to the store
steps: Open the Log in page and enter email and password
Click 'Log in' and confirm you are taken to the Shop as the logged-in user

demo_journeys.name: Review and manage orders
steps: Open the Orders page and see the list of past orders with totals
Click 'Delete' on order #1000 to remove it from the list

demo_journeys.name: Update account details
steps: Open the Account page and see the current display name and email
Edit the display name field and click 'Save' to persist the change

demo_journeys.name: Admin: view registered users
steps: Open the Admin page and see the table of all registered users with their roles
Confirm the current user's role (user) and the admin account (Alice) are both listed

report.summary: We cannot go to demo on this e-commerce web store; the automated security and design pass returned a "not safe to demo" verdict with 18 critical failures out of 13 pages. Among those criticals are an IDOR that lets one user pull another user's order by tweaking the URL, a privilege escalation through client-side role control on the admin area, and several broken or failing design checks on the home, orders, and login pages. A further 249 checks were never run, 5 were blocked, and 4 still need a human to confirm, so the 423 passed tests do not give us a clean bill of health. I recommend we hold the demo until at minimum the IDOR and privilege-escalation issues are fixed and a re-test confirms the rest.
